comments.comment: AGENTS.md says to link every GitHub issue and pull request you mention, in chat and docs, because only GitHub's own UI turns a bare number into a link; write the number as the text of a Markdown link to its page
comments.failureScenario: The progress-log entry writes #14 as plain text. GitHub turns a bare number into a link only in its own UI, so a reader of the file in an editor or a rendered document has no link to follow to the request.
